meta.setting.contracts.approval.allow-se: Contract internal approval: approve own submission
If Yes, the person who submits a contract for approval can approve their own submission if they have approval authority. The default is No (preparer and approver are separated).
meta.setting.contracts.approval.due-hour: Target decision time for a contract submitted for approval. If exceeded, the approval appears overdue (in the approval work list and on the contract). 0 means off.
meta.setting.contracts.signature.provide: None: manual signature only (the signed document is uploaded and an authorized person verifies it). Simulation: for testing only; it sends no requests or emails to anyone and the signatures have no legal value.
meta.setting.contracts.signature.validit: A signature request expires if not completed within this many days. Between 1 and 90.
meta.setting.contracts.renewal.reminder-: A follow-up activity is opened for the owner this many days before the notice deadline (or the end date if there is none). Comma-separated days (e.g. 90,60,30,7).
meta.setting.contracts.renewal.allow-aut: If Yes, signed contracts whose renewal method is automatic are extended automatically by the renewal term once the notice deadline has passed and the period ends. When No (default), no contract is extended automatically.
meta.setting.contracts.document.provider: Appears in the document header and signature area; used in the template with the {{hizmet_veren.unvan}} variable.
Contract document: service provider contact details
Appears in small print under the document header (address, tax ID, phone).
meta.setting.contracts.document.footer-n: Appears at the bottom of every page (e.g. a confidentiality note).
meta.setting.core.profile.display-name.d: Shown in the top bar instead of the company name. If empty, the company's registered name is used.
meta.setting.core.regional.time-zone.des: Dates and times on screens, the audit log and exports use this time zone.
meta.setting.core.regional.currency.desc: Default currency for new records. The currency of existing records does not change.
meta.setting.core.calendar.work-days.des: The number of leave days is calculated based on these days; non-working days and days in the Administration > Public holidays list are excluded. The day count of leave requests already created does not change.
meta.setting.core.calendar.work-hours.de: Calculations that use the company work calendar (e.g. durations measured in business hours) use these hours. Hours are in the company's time zone.
meta.setting.core.regional.language.desc: The company's default language. Users who have chosen a language in their own account see their own language. Stored data does not change.
meta.setting.core.security.require-two-f: If on, users without two-step verification set up an authenticator app before entering the company. To turn it on, your own two-step verification must be enabled.
meta.setting.core.automation.enabled.des: If you choose No, none of this company's automation rules run and queued runs are cancelled; rules are not deleted. It is meant for stopping quickly in case of unexpected behavior.
meta.setting.core.ai.enabled.description: If on, the company's AI features can be used. AI accesses only as much data as the user's own permissions allow, and every action it performs is written to the audit log. While off, no data is sent to AI.
meta.setting.crm.lead.first-contact-targ: The target maximum time until a lead's first contact, in calendar hours (not business hours). If left empty, no target is applied.
meta.setting.crm.opportunity.stage-requi: Fields that must be filled when moving to a stage. Format: Stage=field|field;Stage=field (e.g. Proposal=amount|expectedCloseDate). If left empty, no condition is applied.
meta.setting.crm.opportunity.stage-proba: Default win probability of a stage. Format: Stage=percent;Stage=percent. If the user entered the probability manually, it is not overwritten when the stage changes; 100 is applied for won, and 0 for lost and cancelled.
An open opportunity is considered inactive when this many days have passed since the last customer interaction.
meta.setting.crm.quote.approval-discount: A quote whose total discount exceeds this percentage cannot be presented to the customer without internal approval. If left empty, no approval is required for discounts.
meta.setting.crm.quote.approval-gross-ab: Quote internal approval: total amount threshold
A quote whose grand total exceeds this amount (in the quote's own currency) cannot be presented without internal approval. If left empty, no approval is required for amount.
meta.setting.crm.quote.default-validity-: Suggested validity period for new quotes.
meta.setting.crm.quote.allow-self-approv: Quote internal approval: approve own submission
If Yes, the person who submits a quote for approval can approve their own quote if they have approver authority. The default is No.
meta.setting.crm.quote.on-accept-win-opp: Mark opportunity as won on quote acceptance
If Yes, when a customer accepts a quote (or the acceptance is recorded), the open opportunity the quote is linked to is closed as won; the won amount is the quote's net total. The default is No.
meta.setting.crm.quote.follow-up-days.de: Once a quote is presented to the customer, a follow-up activity is opened for the quote owner this many days later. 0 means off.
meta.setting.crm.quote.expiry-reminder-d: A reminder activity is opened for the owner this many days before a quote pending with the customer expires. 0 means off.
meta.setting.crm.quote.sync-opportunity-: Sync opportunity amount from primary quote

If Yes, the amount and currency of the open opportunity are set equal to the quote's net total when its primary quote is presented to the customer (and when the primary quote is changed). The default is No; the opportunity amount is entered manually.
meta.setting.crm.quote.approval-reminder: If a quote awaiting approval waits this many hours without a decision, an email reminder is sent once to the named approvers (and their delegates) of that step. It is not sent for a step with no named approver. 0 means off.
meta.setting.crm.quote.reply-reminder-da: The My day tab on the CRM dashboard suggests reminding about a quote that was presented to the customer and has had no response for this many days. 0 means off. The opportunity inactivity suggestion uses the Opportunity inactivity threshold.
meta.setting.crm.reporting.fiscal-year-s: Quarter and year periods are set up based on this month (1 = January). The month period is always the calendar month. Defined targets and locked forecasts are stored with their dates, so the past does not change.
meta.setting.crm.forecast.commit-min-pro: An open opportunity with a probability at or above this value falls into the Commit category in the forecast by default. A manager can change the category with a justification.
meta.setting.crm.forecast.best-case-min-: Forecast: minimum probability for Best Case (%)
An open opportunity with a probability at or above this value (below the Commit threshold) falls into the Best case category by default; below it is Pipeline, and those at 0 are Omitted.
meta.setting.crm.quote.seller-details.de: Appears in the header of the customer quote document (PDF) under the company name: such as address, phone, tax office/number. May be left empty.
meta.setting.crm.quote.footer-note.descr: A short note shown at the bottom of every page of the customer quote document. May be left empty.
meta.setting.logistics.trips.credential-: What should happen when a vehicle, trailer or driver document (inspection, insurance, license, SRC…) has expired while marking a trip ready? Warn: approval is given with a warning and the warning is stored on the trip. Block: the trip cannot be marked ready until the document is renewed.
meta.setting.logistics.default-country.d: The country used when no loading or delivery country is entered on a transport request or shipment. Enter an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (e.g. TR, DE, BG). An invalid value is treated as Türkiye (TR).
meta.setting.logistics.trips.cancel-pend: What should happen to expenses awaiting approval when a trip is cancelled? Keep pending: the expense stays with the approver, who approves it with a reason, rejects it or moves it to another trip (real spending made before the trip started is not lost). Reject: they are rejected in the same operation as the cancellation with the reason "Trip cancelled"; if it was real spending, the expense is resubmitted for approval. Rejected and approved expenses do not change.
meta.setting.marketing.provider.descript: Default: no provider, real sending is blocked. The 'Test provider' sends the message nowhere; it is for trial and development only. Real email/SMS providers are not available in this version.
meta.setting.marketing.frequency.daily-l: Marketing: daily message limit per address
The number of marketing messages that can go to one contact point in a day (in the company time zone); counted jointly across campaigns. 0 turns the limit off.
meta.setting.marketing.approval.required: If Yes, a run submitted for approval is approved by someone with approval authority other than its preparer (segregation of duties). If No, the send is considered approved directly.
meta.setting.orders.jobs.strategy.descri: How jobs are created when a handover is accepted. By type: product items become a single 'Delivery' job, and service/package items become a single 'Service start' job. Single job: all items in one job. Per item: each item is a separate job.
meta.setting.orders.jobs.service-after-d: Operations job: service job starts after delivery job
If Yes (with the by-type strategy), the service start job cannot be started before the delivery job is completed; the dependency is enforced on the server.
meta.setting.orders.jobs.unassigned-hour: Operations job: assignment wait warning time (hours)
If a job awaiting assignment stays unassigned longer than this, a follow-up activity is opened once for the user who accepted the handover. 0 means off.
meta.setting.orders.handover.accept-due-: Sales handover: target time for acceptance (days)
Due date of the follow-up activity opened for a handover sent to operations (days from sending). Between 1 and 30.
meta.setting.orders.handover.wait-hours: Sales handover: acceptance wait warning time (hours)
If a handover sent to operations is not accepted for longer than this, a follow-up activity is opened once for the sales owner. 0 means off.

meta.setting.support.auto-close-days: Support: auto-close period for resolved tickets (days)
meta.setting.support.auto-close-days.des: If this many days pass in the Resolved status without a customer objection, the ticket closes automatically (scheduled job). 0 means off (default). A customer message reopens the ticket; customer confirmation closes it immediately.
meta.setting.support.survey.enabled: Support: send satisfaction survey on resolution
meta.setting.support.survey.enabled.desc: If Yes, when a ticket is resolved, a time-limited, single-use survey link is written to the email queue if the requester has an email. The default is No.
meta.setting.support.acknowledgement.ena: Support: send automatic acknowledgement when a ticket is opened

If Yes, when a ticket is opened, an automatic reply with the ticket number is written to the email queue if the requester has an email. The automatic reply does not count as the first response and does not stop the SLA timer. The default is No.
meta.setting.support.survey.valid-days.d: The survey link becomes invalid after this period. Between 1 and 90.
meta.setting.support.survey.reminder-day: If no answer arrives this many days after the survey email and the link has not expired, one reminder email is sent (scheduled job). 0 is off (default). Between 0 and 30.
meta.setting.support.complaint.require-r: Support: root cause required when resolving complaints
If Yes, a complaint-type ticket cannot be resolved without a root cause and corrective action being entered.
